@@U03821@@
His mother calls anxiously to him:
“Spring, spring to your heart’s content,
but beware of flying!
It’s not for you to fly!”
And his living father warned him as well:
“In the earth lies the force that will thrust you upward.
Touch it with only your toe,
you'll have the strength of that son of earth,
安泰俄斯.”
And so he leaps, like a batted ball,
from one massive rock face to another,
bouncing freely every which way.
Then all at once he vanishes down a savage ravine
and seems lost to us forever.
Mother weeps; father comforts;
and I shrug my shoulders,
concerned and anxious.
Then suddenly he’s there again!
Ah, what a sight!
Has he found treasures buried down there?
He’s dressed now in flowered robes,
tassels dangling from his arms, ribbons
fluttering at his breast,
and like a miniature 阿波罗,
with golden lyre in hand,
cheerfully approaches the edge
of the precipice above us.
Wonderful!
His parents embrace in delight.
What glory is it shines about his head?
A halo?
It’s hard to say.
A golden ornament?
translation:
@@U03821@@
他的母亲焦急地喊他：
“春天，春天，让你心满意足，
但要小心飞行！
又不是让你飞的！”
他活着的父亲也警告他：
“大地里蕴藏着推动你向上的力量。
只用脚趾触碰它，
你将拥有大地之子的力量，
安泰俄斯。”
于是他像被击中的球一样跳跃，
从一个巨大的岩石表面到另一个巨大的岩石表面，
向各个方向自由弹跳。
然后他突然消失在一个野蛮的峡谷中
我们似乎永远失去了它。
母亲哭泣；父亲安慰；
我耸耸肩，
担心和焦虑。
然后突然他又出现了！
啊，多么壮观啊！
他是否发现了埋藏在下面的宝藏？
他现在穿着花袍，
手臂上垂下的流苏、丝带
在他胸前飘扬，
又像一个微型的阿波罗，
手里拿着金色的七弦琴，
愉快地接近边缘
我们上方的悬崖。
精彩的！
他的父母欣喜地拥抱在一起。
他的头上闪耀着怎样的荣耀？
光环？
很难说。
金色的装饰品？
